title: Deck
description: A player's deck: card counts + the format it targets. Decks are data like everything else — shareable, diffable, forkable. Files: decks/*.json.

format_id.description: Format this deck targets. Legality is checked against it (card pool + active restriction + deck_rules).

printings.description: Optional production lock: printing_id -> copy count. When present, counts grouped by card_id must exactly equal cards. This lets one saved deck select an exact edition or alt-art face without changing gameplay identity.

notes.description: Strategy notes, changelog thinking — diffs like everything else.
